verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside LiveKit that a user can hand tasks to. LiveKit Agents is a framework for building your own agents. Agent Builder is a no-code tool for prototyping and deploying voice agents, not an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks. The coding-agent mention refers to external tools like Claude Code and Cursor, which are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
